newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks close tad higher, seen flat.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks close tad higher, seen flat.

text.p: Argentine stocks closed marginally higher Thursday in a market pressured by the arrival of new players Merrill Lynch, dealers said.

"The start of Merrill Lynch trades on the bolsa today kept a lid on prices, because since market conditions are overbought everyone wanted to sell to them," said Jose Napoli of Ignoto y Napoli traders.
Merrill inaugurated its seat on the stock exchange Thursday, its third in Latin America after Mexico and Brazil.
The blue-chip MerVal index added 0.1 percent to close at 603.03, standing virtually flat on the week.
